name: Side Events under the Mistletoe FXBG 2026
information:
**This competition only has side events and not 3x3x3 Cube, therefore, we do not recommend it for new competitors. If you're looking for a more conventional cubing competition, you might be interested in [other competitions in Virginia](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?search=Virginia); Such as [RVAutumn 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RVAutumn2026).**

A location of FMC under the Mistletoe will be hosted during this competition. Registration is free, but must be completed seperately. See the [FMC under the Mistletoe Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FXBGMistletoe2026#81612-fmc-under-the-mistletoe) for more information. NO on the spot registrations will be honored for FMC.

This competition will be using a different format than what is usually seen at competitions. See the [Competition Format Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FXBGMistletoe2026#81742-competition-format) for more information.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab. Additionally, we recommend you attend the Newcomers Tutorial at the beginning of the Competition.
